title: Rav Huna son of Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Kamma 72a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.72a.8), rejecting the difficulty that Rav Chavivi of Mechoza had raised against Rav Ashi; Rav Ashi said to him, “Do not reject it.” Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Acha son of Rava, as cited [there at 72b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.72b.2).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli has Rav Chavivi question Rav Ashi on 72a. The continuation at 72b names Rav Acha son of Rava. Hyman reports Acha from Dikdukei Soferim. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=986&lang=en) heads his entry Rav Huna son of Rava and cites 72a.
